ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for melodic pop vocals, given my interest in Born This Way and Cheek to Cheek.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Cheek to Cheek makes another vocal collaboration album appealing right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This closely fits my interest in mid-'60s songs and familiar greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Antebellum Heart Break; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough here to choose it over familiar older pop.
ItemID: NA; Title: Same Trailer Different Park; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in classic pop and folk favorites than exploring this country album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: From A Room: Volume 1; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This feels less connected to the older pop and compilation albums I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: 16 Biggest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A hits collection appeals, but without an artist I cannot tell whether these are songs I would enjoy.
ItemID: NA; Title: Keith Urban Greatest hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The compilation format fits, but my recent listening gives me little reason to choose Keith Urban now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best ...So Far; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title suggests a compilation, but I need to know the artist before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: All That Echoes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal music can appeal to me, but I would choose the more familiar oldies collection this time.
